from fin.adapters.citi_pdf import CitiPdfAdapter
from fin.ingest import check_control_totals, IngestRejected

# Synthetic pdftotext -layout output, dates inside the stated billing period,
# reproducing the documented hazards: wrapped merchant description, page
# furniture between rows, rewards-column bleed after the real amount, and an
# interest row carrying a single date column. Totals are constructed to
# balance exactly so the control-total gate should accept this one.
text = """Citicards.com
Billing Period: 07/15/26 - 08/14/26
Account number ending in: 4021

Previous balance                              $500.00
Payments                                     -$500.00
Credits                                        -$5.00
Purchases                                     $232.43
Fees                                            $0.00
Interest                                        $4.10
New balance                                   $231.53

Payments, Credits and Adjustments
    08/01         ONLINE PAYMENT, THANK YOU                -$500.00
    08/02  08/01  AMAZON MKTPLACE PMTS Amzn.com/billWA        -$5.00

Standard Purchases
                            LEATHER BY DRAGONFLY
    07/20                                                    $232.43   1.2X
                            WWW.LEATHERBYOH
402100
Page 1 of 2

Interest Charged
    08/14  INTEREST CHARGE ON PURCHASES                      $4.10

Interest Charge Calculation
    Some rate disclosure text that must not be parsed as a row  $999.99
"""

pf = CitiPdfAdapter().parse_text(text, "citi-costco-4021", "synthetic-statement-2.pdf")
print("rows parsed:", len(pf.rows))
for r in pf.rows:
    print(" ", r.post_date, r.sale_date, r.kind, r.amount_cents, repr(r.descriptor))
print("period:", pf.period_start, pf.period_end, "close:", pf.close_date)
print("totals:", pf.totals)
print("warnings:", pf.warnings)

try:
    check_control_totals(pf)
    print("control totals: PASSED (statement'"'"'s own arithmetic reproduced exactly)")
except IngestRejected as exc:
    print("control totals: REJECTED ->", exc)
PY'
